guard/30546.htm.text: Defender Dinkey: Hi, I'm Dinkey! I just started my new job here! I've really got a lot to learn. By the way, I've heard that you really need to watch out for the monsters around here!

links.text: "Who is the Lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"
